import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    cost = []
    s = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        s += -1 if arr[i] % 2 == 0 else 1
        if s == 0:
            cost.append(abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]))
    cost.sort()
    tcost = 0
    maxp = 0
    for c in cost:
        if tcost + c <= b:
            tcost += c
            maxp += 1
    print(maxp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
